paper.title: VoxPoser: Composable 3D Value Maps for Robotic Manipulation with Language Models
paper.central_claim: LLM-generated programs compose observation-grounded 3D affordance/constraint maps for motion-planner trajectory synthesis across open-set instructions/objects without task-specific training or reliance on acquiring individual primitives; replanning yields disturbance robustness, and trajectory priors enable efficient online contact-dynamics learning.

signatures.information: Instruction, RGB-D with metric calibration; OWL-ViT→SAM→XMEM object/part point clouds; known robot model; engineered API and5–20 examples/LMP.
signatures.operation: High-level LMP decomposes instruction; composer calls perception/map LMPs; Python/NumPy produce100^3 affordance/avoidance/rotation/velocity/gripper fields; geometric planner optimizes affordance/avoidance objective, attaches other parameter maps, executes first waypoint and refreshes at5Hz.
signatures.output: Dense6-DoF end-effector trajectories and gripper/velocity commands.
signatures.conditions: Faithful object geometry/calibration and language-to-map semantics; end-effector collision geometry; sufficient heuristic dynamics; prompt/example recipes unspecified in offline payload.
signatures.feedback: Fresh point cloud/map-function evaluation for MPC; no explicitly reported Python-error/solver-verdict→LLM repair procedure.
signatures.selection_rule: Greedy map-based path or random-shooting MPC according to weighted objective; no artifact admission filter claimed.
signatures.data: Pretrained models and in-context examples; real objects/tasks and randomized block-world variants.
signatures.persistence: Code/map functions and tracking state within rollout; base LLM and static harness not updated.
signatures.later_use: Maps re-evaluated on current observation during same rollout; no cross-task retained harness update.
signatures.claimed_effect: Spatial composition beyond sequential primitive calls and robustness to moving obstacles/targets.
signatures.failure_boundary: Approximate proxy objective, perception/geometry limits, end-effector-only planning, pushing still uses predefined primitive, exact prompt-example evidence unavailable.

signatures.information: Zero-shot synthesized waypoint trajectories plus measured environment transitions.
signatures.operation: Start with zero-shot prior; sample noisy nearby actions; collect transitions; fit MLP dynamics by next-state loss; MPC uses fitted model and collects more local data.
signatures.output: Updated task dynamics model and later MPC performance.
signatures.conditions: Prior local neighborhood reaches meaningful contacts; transition measurement/model class adequate; local exploration not a universal dynamics model.
signatures.feedback: Observed next-state prediction error; task success used for final evaluation.
signatures.selection_rule: Action distribution biased around prior trajectories; parameter fit minimizes prediction loss. No independent accepted/rejected skill-store update.
signatures.persistence: MLP dynamics parameters; no language-model/harness-code revision.
signatures.later_use: MPC for subsequent interactions in the same contact task.
signatures.claimed_effect: Faster task-dynamics learning and higher eventual task success.
signatures.failure_boundary: No independent later task/body retention study; no-prior search baseline may be weak; sample time does not price all compute.

gap.author_gap: LLM planners typically compose learned/hand-designed primitives; direct text control cannot express dense high-frequency motion. Need observation-grounded spatial objectives that synthesize action trajectories without acquiring each task primitive.
gap.checked_gap: Fixed text distinguishes code-as-policies primitive parameterization from generated3D fields and explicit downstream optimization. Practical gap well defined, but no independent original costmap/code-policy texts to close novelty.

lineage.verification: Author description/adapted baselines only; originals not in fixed pack.
Independently read; structured numeric waypoints + joint IK/RRT versus dense observation-grounded objective fields with MPC. Does not establish temporal priority.

gap.closest_adjacent: LLM-coded primitive composition and learned-cost-map planning; language/reward generation with classical control.
gap.residue: Specify spatially dense object/part affordances and simultaneous constraints in scene coordinates, then re-evaluate under disturbances.
gap.stakes: Narrow primitive inventory and brittle direct parameter calls limit open-object task coverage and physical robustness.
gap.method_response: Turn language affordances/constraints into executable code and3D value fields as geometric planner objectives; exploit trajectories as local contact-learning priors.
gap.remaining_gap: Maps are approximate semantic proxies; perception, contact/whole-arm dynamics and manual prompt engineering remain; primitive-free claim not universal and some taskwise baselines win.

claims.text: Spatial value-map composition synthesizes robust everyday trajectories beyond sequential primitive calls.
claims.setting: Real Franka tabletop,five representative tasks,static and preselected disturbances.
claims.baseline_control: Variant of Code as Policies with move/rotate/velocity/gripper primitives; same broad perception/control suite but exact prompt parity unknown.
claims.budgets: 10 trials per task×condition×method;20Hz RGB-D and5Hz replanning; no complete LLM-call/wall-clock budget.
claims.selection_vs_test: Representative tasks chosen by authors; prompt-example exposure to these tasks not auditable without linked artifacts.
claims.result_denominator: VoxPoser44/50 static,35/50 disturbed; primitive12/50 static,0/50 disturbed. Task cells have10 trials.
counterevidence: Success thresholds/constraint tolerances and disturbance magnitude not fully operationalized; perception remains primary failure; whole-arm coverage absent; pushing still engineered.
alternative_explanations: Replanning,representation,planner and prompt examples changed together, not solely language semantic understanding.
claims.allowed_conclusion: Strong author-reported aggregate feasibility/robustness within specified setup; not a universal primitive-free or safety-certified manipulation harness.

claims.text: VoxPoser generalizes to unseen instructions and attributes.
claims.setting: 13 custom SAPIEN tasks,2766 instruction pool,seen/unseen attribute lists.
claims.budgets: 20 episodes per task/result entry,not2766 evaluation trials; supervised baseline has training data,LLM has pretrained knowledge and examples.
claims.selection_vs_test: Authors say unseen instructions/attributes absent from prompts/training; exact prompt payload unavailable,development overlap not audited.
claims.result_denominator: Table2 unseen categories favor method in aggregate; per-task Table4 includes unseen move55% vs primitive60%,grasp40% vs70%.
counterevidence: Not every task superior; same narrow colored-block/table setting; exact unseen-to-prompt separation unresolved.
alternative_explanations: Foundation-model semantics and prompt reference distribution rather than generalization of the map mechanism alone.
claims.allowed_conclusion: Author-reported aggregate held-out language/attribute success, not independently certified construction-unseen physical transfer.

claims.text: Zero-shot trajectories provide useful priors for efficient online dynamics learning.
claims.setting: Simulated door/window/fridge contact tasks with task-local MLP.
claims.budgets: Three seeds;prior interaction times~142/137/71 sec vs no-prior>12h learning cap; entire model/optimization cost not counted as interaction time.
claims.selection_vs_test: Online data/model from same task; no independent later task/body retained-gain evaluation.
claims.result_denominator: Table3 eventual success88.3±1.67%,80.0±2.9%,91.7±4.4%;seed error reported,complete evaluation numerator per trained model not explicit in text.
counterevidence: Zero-shot contact success6.7/3.3/18.3%;requires task dynamics training,not equally general zero-shot manipulation.
alternative_explanations: Localized exploration near an informed prior vs full-action random search; no stronger geometric/contact prior control.
claims.allowed_conclusion: Efficient task-local dynamics acquisition under this exploration comparison; not persistent self-improving code or cross-task retained skill evidence.
